| Param | Location | Type | Required |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Non-admin users can only search teams they belong to | authorization | ctx.Doer.IsAdmin is false |
| Team search defaults to including description in search | business_logic | include_desc param is empty string (not provided) |

### Error Paths

- **org not found** → orgAssignment → 404
- **not org member** → reqOrgMembership → 403
- **SearchTeam DB error** → SearchTeam → 500
